answer_1.quote: Our research aims to fill this gap by exploring the following central question: how do generative LLMs influence moral expressions when modifying human-authored content?
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are modified versions of human-authored texts through revision, rewriting, or continuation, with a focus on changes in moral expressions.

answer_2.quote: Our goal is to measure the moral shifts, i.e., the changes in moral expressions into a text after its manipulation by the model. This can be regarded as a twofold objective, since two complementary aspects are (i) the magnitude change in the scores associated to the moral dimensions, and (ii) how much the ranking of the importance (scores) of the moral dimensions has changed.
